mainText: Andrew, confirmed exploitation remains the priority. CISA has listed flaws in MONAI Label and N-able Mail Assure. Medical research systems and email security customers should confirm exposure and investigate earlier access. These items repeat yesterday evening’s briefing. Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and SAP also need documented remediation. Palo Alto customers using HTTP two should confirm their exact fixed release or apply the documented mitigation. Jamaica’s alert reinforces checks on storage, research applications and AI gateways. Today, identify affected systems, obtain patch and investigation evidence, and agree a dated next step with each account owner.
